target: Dynamics 365 CE 9.1 on-prem — HL CRM test and BFD CRM / QDB1 test (one package)

manifest.rootBefore: <ImportExportXml version="9.2.26091.158" SolutionPackageVersion="9.2" languagecode="1033" generatedBy="CrmLive" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" OrganizationVersion="9.2.26091.158" OrganizationSchemaType="Full" CRMServerServiceabilityVersion="9.2.26091.00158">

customizationTransforms.name: root-organisation-attributes
customizationTransforms.why: OrganizationVersion / OrganizationSchemaType / CRMServerServiceabilityVersion are 9.2 export stamps

customizationTransforms.name: empty-autonumber-format
customizationTransforms.why: AutoNumberFormat is empty on every column (no column is auto-numbered)

customizationTransforms.name: teams-integration-flag
customizationTransforms.why: IsMSTeamsIntegrationEnabled is 0 on every table; Teams integration is a Dataverse online feature

customizationTransforms.name: role-auto-assigned-flag
customizationTransforms.why: Role IsAutoAssigned is 0 on every role

customizationTransforms.name: cascade-archive
customizationTransforms.why: Long-term data retention (archive) does not exist on 9.1; there is nothing to cascade

customizationTransforms.name: form-header-density
customizationTransforms.why: headerdensity is a Unified Interface header layout hint; 9.1 renders its default header

customizationTransforms.name: option-is-hidden
customizationTransforms.why: IsHidden="0" on options, states and statuses — no option is hidden

customizationTransforms.name: app-settings
customizationTransforms.why: App settings (AppChannel) require the cloud-only msdyn_AppFrameworkInfraExtensions package

customizationTransforms.name: site-map-name
customizationTransforms.why: A 9.1 server refuses an AppModuleSiteMap without <SiteMapName> ("The SiteMapName in the AppModuleSiteMap is null or empty", 0x80050109 — HL CRM test import, 2026-10-04); the cloud export keeps the name only in LocalizedNames

customizationTransforms.name: foreign-regarding-relationships
customizationTransforms.why: Activity "Regarding" relationships to tables that exist only in the cloud sandbox; the target org generates Regarding relationships for its own activity-enabled tables
